## Before the workshop

Bring your laptop with the latest version of Positron installed.  For this workshop in particular, it may be worth it to install a pre-release (instead of the monthly release). See [Setup](setup.qmd) for detailed instructions.

Join us on [Slack](https://join.slack.com/t/cascadiarconf/shared_invite/zt-1lu53059t-GAxQtzrwQhmo7BXE7YfC8w) and find the `#workshop-intro-to-positron-2025` channel.

## Instructor

[Charlotte Wickham](https://cwick.co.nz) is a Developer Educator at Posit with a focus on Quarto. Before Posit, she taught Statistics and Data Science at Oregon State University.
